nodes.label: AS-CORE-003: Claim Identity v2 Architecture Amendment
Claim Identity v2 (hash of identity_version | project_identity | source_lineage_id | claim_type | normalized_field | stable_semantic_locator)
nodes.rationale: Locator normalization follows a strict priority chain (explicit ID, schema key, semantic anchor, fail-closed) and explicitly forbids brittle structural paths such as AST indices or line numbers; ambiguous identity boundaries must fail closed and quarantine rather than silently drop or arbitrarily prioritize conflicting records.

nodes.label: Optimistic Concurrency Control / pessimistic locking for claim state mutation
nodes.rationale: Guarantees consistency during multi-agent migration, recompilation and continuous ingestion; conflicting or lagging transactions on overlapping claim state must fail closed, rollback safely, and demand a retry.
